relation_rules.label: POS_ASSOCIATED_WITH
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Positively associated with = Positive correlation

relation_rules.label: NEG_ASSOCIATED_WITH
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Negatively associated with example (negative correlation)

relation_rules.label: ASSOCIATED_WITH
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Associated with = unspecified relationship, a correlation

relation_rules.label: ASSOCIATED_WITH
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Associated with = An unspecified relationship, a correlation

relation_rules.label: INTERACTS_WITH
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Interacts with = Acts, functions, or operates together with

relation_rules.label: PREVENTS
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Prevents = Stops, hinders or eliminates

relation_rules.label: CAUSES
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Causes = Brings about a condition or an effect

relation_rules.label: INCREASES
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Increases = Make greater in size, amount, intensity, or degree

relation_rules.label: DECREASES
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Decreases = Make smaller in size, amount, intensity, or degree

relation_rules.label: AFFECTS
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Affects = direct effect whose nature is not explicit

relation_rules.label: HAS_COMPONENT
relation_rules.source: DiMB-RE PURE/icl/prompts/desc_guid_1shot_021424.txt: Has component = one entity is a constituent part of another (subject/object swapped)

relation_rules.label: IMPROVES
relation_rules.source: IMPROVES describes improved quality/condition; not equivalent to treatment

relation_rules.label: INCREASES
relation_rules.source: LitKG ACTIVATES requires an explicit mechanism

relation_rules.label: DECREASES
relation_rules.source: LitKG INHIBITS requires an explicit mechanism
